battle.name: 卡拉卡拉的安息戰爭
battle.theater: 美索不達米亞與亞美尼亞
battle.brief: 公元216年，卡拉卡拉藉拒婚開戰，自安條克發兵，經亞美尼亞入安息，掃蕩底格里斯河東岸。安息王阿爾塔巴努斯避戰退走，泰西封空，羅軍未捉住國王，冬退埃德薩。翌年4月8日卡拉卡拉遇刺，217年秋安息勝尼斯比斯，羅馬退出美索不達米亞。卡面秦連弩早四百年，戰場吃緊在安息弓騎與火攻攻城器。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 交戰的兩方是羅馬帝國與安息帝國（帕提亞、亦即阿爾薩契王朝），一邊的樞紐在羅馬的安條克與整個敘利亞省，另一邊在安息的美索不達米亞核心泰西封。羅馬一方由皇帝卡拉卡拉親自統率，帝國正軍以軍團為骨幹：其中第二安息軍團（Legio II Parthica）因為長期在東方邊境同安息人對峙而得名，被皇帝視為直屬精銳，安排在中軍近衛的位置；第三高盧軍團、第六鐵軍團與其餘各軍團，加上各由軍隊總指揮（praefectus）率領的輔助步兵與輔助騎兵（auxilia），編為兩翼；皇室的禁衛軍（praetorians）與一部分禁衛騎兵（equites praetoriani）跟著皇帝本人，另有從高盧、不列顛、多瑙河調來的後續部隊與工匠隊隨行。羅馬的指揮體系極度集中：皇帝一身兼最高統帥、執政官與最高祭司，戰地決策幾乎全部出自他一人之口，連陣形都要按他個人偏愛的樣子重排。安息一方由國王阿爾塔巴努斯四世坐鎮泰西封，兵力分散在美索不達米亞的城鎮、北方亞美尼亞的山地，以及幼發拉底河與底格里斯河兩岸遊動的騎兵團；安息軍隊的特色是大量乘騎弓手與重裝步兵混編，國王居中調度，前線多由地方守將與部落首領分擔，補給靠就地徵集與騎兵掠奪，幾乎不靠遠程輸送。第三方並非旁觀：中立的奧斯羅埃恩（Osroene）王國橫在兩軍之間的幼發拉底河上游，亞美尼亞則是雙方都想拿到手的高原，它在 214 年被羅馬收為客戶國，隨後又倒向安息，成為 216 年棋盤上最敏感的一枚子。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Roman Empire and the Parthian Empire, that is the Arsacid dynasty, one side pivoting on Antioch and the whole province of Syria and the other on Ctesiphon in the Parthian heartland of Mesopotamia. The Roman force was led in person by the emperor Caracalla, the imperial army resting on the framework of the legions: the Second Parthian Legion (Legio II Parthica), which had taken its name from long service on the eastern frontier against the Parthians, was treated by the emperor as his own picked body and was posted in the centre close to him; the Third Gallic, the Sixth Ferrata and the remaining legions, together with auxiliary foot and horse (auxilia) under their own prefects, formed the two wings; the Praetorian Guard and a portion of the imperial cavalry (equites praetoriani) stayed with the emperor in person, and further drafts, drawn from Gaul, Britain and the Danube, marched in behind with the engineers and the artisans. The Roman command system was extremely centralised: the emperor was at once supreme commander, consul and chief priest, and on campaign almost every decision came from his own mouth, even the order of battle being recast to suit his own taste. On the Parthian side, the king Artabanus IV sat at Ctesiphon, with his troops dispersed among the towns of Mesopotamia, the highlands of Armenia to the north, and the bands of horse ranged along the Euphrates and the Tigris; the Parthian host was marked by masses of mounted archers mixed with heavy foot, the king directing from the centre while the front line was carried by local governors and tribal chiefs, and supply was drawn from foraging on the spot and from the plunder of the countryside, with almost no long-range transport at all. The third parties were not bystanders: the neutral kingdom of Osroene lay across the upper Euphrates between the two armies, while Armenia, the high plateau both sides wanted to hold, had been reduced to a Roman client state in 214 and then swung back to the Parthians, which made it the most sensitive piece on the board in 216.
people: 決定這場戰爭命運的第一個是卡拉卡拉本人。他是塞維魯斯王朝的皇帝，父親塞普蒂米烏斯·塞維魯斯，母親茱莉婭·多瑪；他七歲時改名為馬庫斯·奧勒留·安托寧，成年後以高盧式的兜帽罩衫得了「卡拉卡拉」這個綽號，敵人與後世史家則多稱他「塔勞塔斯」。他登位後殺死共治的弟弟蓋塔，晚年沉迷於模仿亞歷山大大帝：頭盔上裝對方式的獅角，部隊按馬其頓方陣的縱隊作戰，自稱新亞歷山大。216 年他先向安息王阿爾塔巴努斯四世求婚，遭拒之後立刻抓住這次受辱當作開戰的藉口；求婚從來不是想娶公主，而是要以王朝聯合的名義把安息收進羅馬的宗主體系。安息王阿爾塔巴努斯四世是這場戰爭裡另一位關鍵人物：他避免正面會戰，一退再退，焚燒城郊與田莊，把羅馬遠征軍拖進一場無休止的消耗，最後在 217 年秋於尼斯比斯擊敗羅馬軍，卻沒有乘勢追擊進取，給了羅馬喘息與議和的機會。刺殺卡拉卡拉的是禁衛軍士兵尤斯丁·馬爾提亞利斯，他因為求百夫長之職被拒而心懷怨恨，於 217 年 4 月 8 日在埃德薩通往卡爾海的路上行凶；皇帝隨行的西徐利亞侍衛先用矛刺殺兇手，兩名禁衛軍軍官再補上致命的一擊。三天之後禁衛軍總監馬克里努斯登基，這個利用刺殺者上位的人隨即處死了刺殺者本人，卻把羅馬拖進另一場宮廷血案；後來推翻馬克里努斯、扶立塞維魯斯家族的茱莉婭·多瑪，正是這場戰爭另一端的見證者。
peopleEn: The first man to decide the fate of this war was Caracalla himself. He was an emperor of the Severan dynasty, son of Septimius Severus and Julia Domna; at the age of seven he was renamed Marcus Aurelius Antoninus, and as a grown man he took the nickname Caracalla from the hooded Gallic tunic he habitually wore, while enemy sources and later historians generally called him Tarautas. Having seized the throne he had his co-emperor brother Geta murdered, and in his later years he was obsessed with imitating Alexander the Great: lions' horns on the helmet, troops drawn up in Macedonian phalanx columns, and a habit of styling himself a new Alexander. In 216 he first offered to marry the daughter of the Parthian king Artabanus IV, and on being refused immediately seized the rebuff as a pretext for war; the marriage offer was never meant to take a princess but to draw Parthia into the Roman orbit under the cover of a dynastic union. Artabanus IV of Parthia was the other key figure: he avoided pitched battle, gave ground again and again, burned the suburbs and the farmsteads, and dragged the Roman expedition into an endless war of attrition, and in the autumn of 217 he beat a Roman army at Nisibis, yet he did not press the advantage, which allowed Rome breathing room and a peace. The man who killed Caracalla was a soldier of the Praetorian Guard, Justin Martialis, who was bitter at being refused the post of centurion, and on 8 April 217 he struck on the road from Edessa towards Carrhae; the Scythian bodyguard of the emperor killed the assassin with his lance first, and two Praetorian officers then finished the deed. Three days later the Praetorian prefect Macrinus became emperor, and the man who had used the assassin to seize power had the assassin executed soon after, but in the process he dragged Rome into another round of palace blood; Julia Domna, who would later overthrow Macrinus and set up the Severan family, was a witness to the other end of this war.
kits: 卡面這件秦連弩是中國的兵器，約成於公元前 200 年前後：弩機把拉力事先存進弩匣裡，矢匣一次容納十矢上下，操作者踩下扳機便一矢接一矢地射出，不必反覆拉弦上弦，中間的機件自行復位。它距公元 216 年的這場戰爭有四百多年，地理上更是相隔萬里，因此本役現場不可能出現任何一件這樣的連發弩；同樣地，羅馬與安息也不可能知道這種蓄力矢匣的用法。戰場上真正決定射程與攻城成敗的，是另外一些東西。羅馬方面：步兵以短劍（gladius）、重標槍（pilum）與大盾（scutum）為核心，配環節甲（lorica segmentata）或鎖子甲；遠程有制式弓（sagitta）與扭力弩、石弩（ballista、cheiroballistra），攻城靠投石機（onager）與希臘火火箭，騎兵為圖拉真式與哈德良式裝具騎兵，攜長矛與投槍。安息方面：主力是複合反曲弓，即安息弓，能在騎馬疾馳之際命中目標，箭鏃以鐵或骨為之；步兵配長矛（hasta）與蒙皮草編的大盾（spara），盾高及身，弓手可藏在其後放箭；重裝騎兵（cataphracti）披鱗甲、配鎧馬具作具裝衝鋒。攻城與反攻城同樣是裝備競賽：安息守軍用火箭與火油燒毀逼近的攻城塔與器械，羅馬則以緊密大盾方陣護住投射手作業。運輸上，羅軍靠雙輪貨車與軍用道路，從安條克到泰西封的陸路行程超過一千公里，冬季糧食仍須由敘利亞方向接運；安息軍則以騎兵機動與就地取給作戰。
kitsEn: The repeating crossbow on the card is a Chinese weapon, made at some point around 200 BC: the lock stores the pull of the bow in advance inside the housing, the magazine holds on the order of ten bolts, and the operator simply trips a pedal to send bolt after bolt away without re-drawing and re-cocking the string, the mechanism resetting itself between shots. It stands more than four hundred years and a great many thousands of kilometres away from the war of 216, so no such repeating bow can have been present on the field of this campaign; equally, neither Rome nor Parthia could have known the principle of a spring magazine fed with bolts. The things that really decided range and the fate of the sieges were quite different. On the Roman side the infantry was built on the short sword (gladius), the heavy pilum and the large scutum, with either segmented plate (lorica segmentata) or mail; at range were the service bow (sagitta) and torsion weapons, the ballista and the cheiroballistra, while sieges were conducted with the onager and with Greek fire rockets, and the cavalry was made up of Trajanic and Hadrianic mounted troops carrying the long thrusting spear and the throwing javelin. On the Parthian side the mass of the army was the composite recurved bow, the Parthian bow, which could hit a target at full gallop, with iron or bone heads; the foot carried the long spear (hasta) and the hide-covered wicker shield (spara), tall enough to cover the man and to let an archer shoot from behind it; and the cataphracti went over in scale armour with armoured horse trapping, charging as fully armoured cavalry. Siege and counter-siege were likewise a contest of equipment: the Parthian defenders used fire arrows and burning oil to destroy the siege towers and engines that came up, while the Romans covered their artillery with close-packed shield walls. In transport the Roman column relied on two-wheeled wagons and military roads, the land route from Antioch to Ctesiphon running to more than a thousand kilometres, and winter grain still had to be carried up from Syria; the Parthian army, by contrast, fought on its own mobility and on supplies taken on the spot.
tactics: 卡拉卡拉的戰術帶有很強的個人風格。他把禁衛軍與第二安息軍團等精銳集中在身側，企圖以密集縱隊模仿馬其頓方陣去衝破安息騎兵，實際作戰中他常把數千人的縱隊收成長陣，弓箭手配置在兩翼，騎兵在更外側尋找戰機，這在羅馬的戰役史上是相當前衛的做法。安息軍則完全避免正面會戰：國王帶著主力在羅軍前方平行移動，邊退邊焚燒村莊、田地與城郊糧倉，使羅軍的攻城器械與行軍隊伍失去補給；當羅軍騎兵在平原上追擊時，安息弓騎突然回身射擊，用密集箭雨把追兵壓了回去，屢次得手。在美索不達米亞平原的騎兵交鋒裡，羅馬騎兵一度佔盡上風，安息人卻靠回身射與佯退把戰局扳平。攻城方面，羅軍曾逼近泰西封與其他城鎮，卻屢屢受阻；安息守軍以火箭焚燒羅馬的攻城塔與器械，羅軍終究沒有拿下泰西封。卡拉卡拉本人在冬季把大軍分駐各城、自己駐紮埃德薩，這種分散駐紮有利於補給，卻讓他離開了前線，給了刺客近身的機會；這一點正是安息得以拖到翌年反敗為勝的關鍵。
tacticsEn: Caracalla's tactics carried a strong stamp of his own personality. He massed the Praetorian Guard and picked units such as the Second Parthian Legion around himself, meaning to break the Parthian horse with dense columns modelled on the Macedonian phalanx; in practice he often drew several thousand men into a long close order, with archers on the flanks and the cavalry further out on the wings looking for an opening, which was remarkably forward-thinking for a Roman battle. The Parthian army avoided pitched battle altogether: the king moved his main body in parallel ahead of the Romans, burning villages, fields and the granaries outside the towns as he withdrew, so that the Roman siege train and its columns lost their supply; and when the Roman cavalry pursued across the plain, the Parthian horse archers turned in the saddle and shot, pressing the pursuers back with a shower of arrows, and doing so repeatedly with success. In the cavalry fighting on the Mesopotamian plain the Roman horse had the better of it for a time, but the Parthians levelled the contest through the return shot and the feigned retreat. On the attack against the towns the Romans came close to Ctesiphon and other settlements and were held off again and again; the Parthian defenders fired rockets at the Roman siege towers and engines and burned them, and the Romans never took Ctesiphon. In the winter Caracalla quartered the main army in separate towns and held himself at Edessa; dispersing the army suited supply, but it took the emperor away from the front and gave an assassin his chance, and that was precisely what allowed Parthia to last until the following year and turn the tables.
data: 有根據可寫的數字大致如下。戰役自 216 年春天開始：卡拉卡拉在 215 年 12 月仍在亞歷山卓停留，216 年 3 月或 4 月回到安條克，並在 5 月 27 日之前率軍出發，其後經亞美尼亞南下，於同年夏天進入底格里斯河東岸的安息腹地。安條克到泰西封的直線距離約八百多公里，實際行軍路線超過一千一百公里。216 年冬，他退守埃德薩，也就是今天土耳其的尚勒烏爾法；217 年 4 月 8 日他在那裡遇刺，年二十九歲，三天後馬克里努斯即位。羅馬在東方戰線上的一支偏師同年秋季在尼斯比斯，也就是今天土耳其的努塞伊比恩，被阿爾塔巴努斯四世擊敗，尼斯比斯重新落入安息之手，羅軍隨即退出美索不達米亞；安息與新皇帝之間的議和延續到 218 年。兵員方面，古代記載多為概數，可靠的判斷是羅軍投入東線的兵力以數個帝國軍團加上大量輔助步兵與騎兵計，總量在數萬的量級；安息方面的常備主力亦在數萬上下，另有為數不少的臨時徵集與遊騎。關於羅馬支付給安息的賠款，史料留下的數目互相矛盾，因此此處只作定性描述，不列無法核實的數字。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. The campaign opened in the spring of 216: Caracalla was still at Alexandria in December 215, returned to Antioch in March or April 216, and set out with his army before 27 May, after which he moved south through Armenia and entered the Parthian heartland east of the Tigris in the summer of that year. The direct distance from Antioch to Ctesiphon is a little over eight hundred kilometres, and the actual line of march ran to more than eleven hundred. In the winter of 216 he fell back to Edessa, the modern Şanlıurfa in south-eastern Turkey; on 8 April 217 he was killed there at the age of twenty-nine, and three days later Macrinus became emperor. A Roman detachment on the eastern front was beaten by Artabanus IV at Nisibis, the modern Nusaybin in Turkey, in the autumn of that year; Nisibis fell back into Parthian hands and the Romans withdrew from Mesopotamia, and the peace between Parthia and the new emperor was concluded in 218. On the strength of the troops, the ancient figures are mostly round numbers, and the safe reading is that the Romans committed several imperial legions with a large body of auxiliary foot and horse to the eastern front, on the order of tens of thousands; the Parthian standing army was of a similar order, with a substantial addition of hastily raised levies and irregular horse. As for the indemnity Rome paid to Parthia, the numbers in the sources contradict one another, so only a qualitative statement is made here and no unverifiable figure is quoted.
cause: 開戰有直接與深層兩重原因。直接原因是安息王阿爾塔巴努斯四世拒絕了卡拉卡拉的求婚。皇帝提出迎娶國王的女兒，實際意圖是以王朝聯合的名義把安息納入羅馬的宗主體系；對方看穿了這一點，毫不客氣地回絕。卡拉卡拉隨即把這次外交上的受辱當成開戰的藉口，216 年春天自安條克出發，軍隊經亞美尼亞深入安息境內，轉而襲擊底格里斯河東岸的鄉野與城鎮。深層的原因是安息與羅馬在美索不達米亞的長期角力。213 年前後安息曾大舉入侵美索不達米亞、圍困羅馬重鎮尼斯比斯，214 年羅軍解圍並據有該城，把邊界往北推了一段；安息一直想收復這一帶，也一直想在羅馬的東方邊界上找回主動。卡拉卡拉的東征正好遇上安息王位交替後的內部鬆動，他相信可以用一次攻勢把泰西封與美索不達米亞的門戶一併奪下；同時他需要在東方保持高昂的聲勢來鞏固剛建立的獨裁地位——他把這場戰爭也當成塑造「第二個亞歷山大」形象的機會，而他在 215 年 12 月亞歷山卓事件之後面對的東方式懼與怨，正好被安息一方看穿並加以利用。
causeEn: There were both an immediate and a deeper cause for the war. The immediate one was the refusal by the Parthian king Artabanus IV of Caracalla's proposal of marriage. The emperor offered to take the king's daughter as his wife, with the real intention of drawing Parthia into the Roman orbit under the cover of a dynastic union; the other side saw straight through it and declined without ceremony. Caracalla promptly converted the diplomatic rebuff into a pretext for war, setting out from Antioch in the spring of 216 with an army that passed through Armenia into Parthian territory, and turned on the villages and towns east of the Tigris. The deeper cause was the long contest between Parthia and Rome over Mesopotamia. Around 213 Parthia had invaded Mesopotamia in force and besieged the Roman fortress of Nisibis; in 214 the Romans relieved it and held the city, pushing the frontier further north, and Parthia had wanted that district back ever since, together with the initiative on Rome's eastern border. Caracalla's expedition arrived at a moment when the succession of the Parthian throne had loosened things internally, and he believed a single offensive could seize Ctesiphon and the whole doorway of Mesopotamia at once; at the same time he needed a high profile in the east to consolidate the autocracy he had only just established, and this war offered him the chance to build the image of a second Alexander. The eastern fear and resentment that followed the affair at Alexandria in December 215 were read correctly by the Parthian side and duly exploited.
impact: 這場戰爭的後果，比戰場上的勝負本身走得更遠。第一，羅馬在美索不達米亞的經營被徹底打回原形。216 至 217 年失去泰西封與亞美尼亞方向的控制之後，帝國放棄了美索不達米亞的省份，改以奧斯羅埃恩王國與亞美尼亞的客戶國作為緩衝，邊界退到幼發拉底河上游；安息則在阿爾塔巴努斯四世及其弟米特拉達特斯二世統治下，獲得約十年相對安寧，直到塞維魯斯·亞歷山大時代羅軍再度東來。第二，羅馬帝國的內部政治被這場失敗連鎖改寫：卡拉卡拉陣亡、馬克里努斯弒君即位、隨即又由茱莉婭·多瑪支持的塞維魯斯家族推翻，三年之內換了四位皇帝，禁衛軍成了真正的選帝人；卡拉卡拉本人被追尊為神化的安托寧，遺體運回羅馬安葬，浴場在 216 年部分落成。第三，這場東征也把帝國財政推到極限：安提尼亞努斯新幣的發行與浴場的興建都靠同一筆收入，而遠征的開支與戰敗後的賠款正是這筆財政最沉重的負擔，貨幣跟著貶值，安息戰事成了加速塞維魯斯王朝崩解的一根引線。
impactEn: The consequences of this war reached considerably further than the fighting on the field. First, the Roman position in Mesopotamia was thoroughly undone. Having lost Ctesiphon and the Armenian approaches in 216 and 217, the empire gave up the Mesopotamian province and fell back on the kingdom of Osroene and on the client kingdom of Armenia as a buffer, with the frontier drawn back to the upper Euphrates; Parthia, under Artabanus IV and then his brother Mithridates II, enjoyed roughly a decade of comparative security, until the Romans came east again in the reign of Severus Alexander. Second, the internal politics of the Roman Empire were rewritten by the failure: Caracalla killed, Macrinus rising by murder and then overthrown by the Severan family with the support of Julia Domna, four emperors in three years, and the Praetorian Guard made the real electoral body; Caracalla himself was deified as Antoninus the Divine, his body carried back to Rome for burial, and his baths were partly inaugurated in 216. Third, the eastern expedition pushed imperial finances to the limit: the issue of the new antoninianus and the building of the baths both drew on the same revenue, while the cost of the campaign and the indemnity paid after the defeat were the heaviest burdens on that revenue, the coinage followed, and the Parthian war became one of the fuses that hastened the collapse of the Severan dynasty.
result: 結果是羅馬方面的失敗。216 年的攻勢沒有任何一項目標達成：泰西封沒有拿下，安息王阿爾塔巴努斯四世始終未被捉到，安息政權完好；安息方面採用的退走與焚燒策略，成功地把羅馬遠征軍拖成一支飢餓而疲憊的隊伍，把戰爭的主動權一直握在國王手裡。217 年 4 月 8 日，卡拉卡拉本人在埃德薩附近遇刺身亡，統帥一死，遠征軍的士氣與計劃一併崩解；同年秋天安息王在尼斯比斯大破羅軍，奪回這座要塞，羅軍放棄美索不達米亞，退回安條克一線，218 年在馬克里努斯主持下議和，羅馬支付賠款並放棄對美索不達米亞與亞美尼亞的宗主要求，安息以歐亞門戶的地位換來了休整。從兵器與技術的角度看，這一役留下的教訓也被後世記住：安息弓騎在平原上的機動射擊能抵消羅馬方陣的正面衝力，羅馬的攻城器械在缺乏制海與制空配合時極易被火攻破壞，而以皇帝本人作為全軍重心、深入敵境數百公里的作戰方式，一旦指揮官出事就沒有任何備案可用。
resultEn: The outcome was a Roman defeat. Not one of the objectives of the offensive of 216 was achieved: Ctesiphon was not taken, Artabanus IV was never caught, and the Parthian state came through intact; the Parthian strategy of giving ground and burning the country turned the Roman expedition into a hungry and exhausted force and kept the initiative firmly in the king's hands throughout. On 8 April 217 Caracalla himself was killed near Edessa, and with the commander dead the morale and the plan of the expedition collapsed together; in the autumn of that year the Parthian king broke a Roman army at Nisibis and retook the fortress, the Romans abandoned Mesopotamia and fell back to the line of Antioch, and in 218 a peace was concluded under Macrinus, Rome paying an indemnity and giving up its claims to suzerainty over Mesopotamia and Armenia, while Parthia bought a period of rest in its position at the doorway between Europe and Asia. Viewed in terms of arms and technique, the lessons of this campaign were remembered afterwards: the mobile shooting of the Parthian horse on the open plain could cancel the frontal shock of the Roman line; Roman siege engines, unaccompanied by command of the sea or the air, were extremely vulnerable to fire; and a method of war that made the emperor himself the fulcrum of the whole army and pushed him hundreds of kilometres into the enemy's country had no fallback at all once the commander was struck down.
